purpose: Turn the validated Part I story spine into a denser playable film-experience without changing required outcomes: more companionship, local life, social play, travel texture, environmental reactions and optional exploration between canon anchors.

canon_policy.extended_edition_policy: Extended-edition character/world moments may enrich pacing when they do not contradict the theatrical core.
canon_policy.dialogue_policy: Preserve scene intent with original game writing; do not reproduce screenplay dialogue.
canon_policy.side_content_policy: Optional play may expand unused time/space between required film anchors but may not change required outcomes.

experience_rules: The player should spend meaningful time with companions before danger escalates.
Every chapter should alternate story pressure with exploration, social texture or environmental discovery.
Named-character behavior should reflect chapter context without creating alternate canon outcomes.
Ambient life must remain bounded by the existing distance-throttled simulation and target-device budget.
No new activity may block the main quest or invalidate save/route continuity.

chapters.focus: Live in the Shire before being forced to leave it.
playable_enrichment: Green Dragon revelry and friendship beat before the party
party-field dancing, food, errands and harmless mischief
firework-mischief aftermath represented as an interactive world beat without copying film dialogue
optional field-path race/play beat with Shire friends
garden, mill, market, fields and ferry discoveries
story-state ambient dialogue that turns from comic/local to uneasy as the Riders approach

chapters.focus: Make Bree feel crowded, suspicious and socially reactive.
playable_enrichment: social attention escalation around the Ring incident
quiet Strider trust-building before the night attack
dawn departure with reduced ambient activity

chapters.focus: Turn wilderness travel into companionship under rising fear.
Use Rivendell as a real social refuge before the Council.
playable_enrichment: Elf routines, books, lanterns and overlook discoveries

chapters.focus: Make the Fellowship feel like a travelling group with personalities.
Use silence, scale and companion reactions instead of civilian life.
Let grief and wonder coexist in Lothlorien.
Let ordinary camp/travel tension fracture into the breaking of the Fellowship.

this_batch: Shire friendship/revelry activity roles and optional beats
film-experience plan expansion for all eight chapters
story-safe companion/social discovery beats using existing quest-trigger/NPC systems
machine guards for the new experience contract
later_asset_dependent: final cinematic cameras and authored cutscenes
